newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius stock exchange index marginally down.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius stock exchange index marginally down.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index was marginally down by 0.14 points to 385.35 on Friday following a share price drop in hotel-based Sun Resorts.
Turnover was posted at 18.13 million rupees on 1,064,788 shares from 23.27 million rupees on 780,920 shares on Wednesday.
Sun Resorts lost 1.50 rupees to 50.00 rupees on 7,000 shares, Grand Baie Hotel was unchanged at 45.00 rupees on 55,150 shares and New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 35.50 rupees on 67,420 shares.

In banking and insurance, State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 13.00 rupees on 709,800 shares, Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 88.00 rupees on 13,084 shares and British American Insurance was five cents lower at 8.50 rupees on 627 shares.

Investment stock policy gained five cents to 4.45 rupees on 94,756 shares, Fincorp lost 50 cents to 72.00 rupees on 700 shares and Promotion and Development was stable at 15.00 rupees on 73,803 shares.
In the commerce sector, conglomerate Rogers was one rupee higher at 103.00 rupees on 1,696 shares and Ireland Blyth Limited rose 10 cents to 14.90 rupees on 3,240 shares.
Happy World Foods was unchanged to 15.20 rupees on 3,400 shares and Shell fell 40 cents to 19.50 rupees on 9,055 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius gained 20 cents to 38.90 rupees on 150 shares.
